title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast 12K Prefilled Kit Bundle
description: The Vaporesso Dojo 12K Bundle offers an extended vaping experience by combining the innovative Dojo Blast 6000 Prefilled Kit with an additional Extra Pod Pack in one convenient set. Together, this bundle provides a total of up to 12,000 puffs, doubling the lifespan of the standard kit and ensuring you stay stocked up for longer. Each component in this bundle—the Kit and the Extra Pod—utilises Vaporesso's smart refill system, featuring a 2ml prefilled pod connected to a 10ml refill container. This unique design keeps the 10mg nicotine salt e-liquid fresh and the coil fully saturated via COREX 2.0 Mesh technology, delivering consistent, smooth flavour from the first puff to the last. Powered by a rechargeable 650mAh battery, the device is compact, reliable, and effortless to use. Vaporesso Dojo Blast 6000 Kit Flavours • Blue Razz Lemonade A vibrant mix of sweet Blue Raspberry and zesty, sparkling Lemonade. • Blueberry Ice Rich, ripe Blueberry notes finished with a crisp and refreshing Ice blast. • Blueberry Sour Raspberry Sweet Blueberry meets tangy Raspberry with a sharp, sour twist. • Double Apple A balanced blend of crisp Green Apple and sweet Red Apple notes. • Kiwi Passionfruit Guava An exotic trio of tangy Kiwi, sweet Passionfruit, and mellow Guava. • Lemon and Lime A classic, zesty pairing of sharp Lemon and bright, citrusy Lime. • Pineapple Ice Juicy tropical Pineapple layered with a cool, breezy Menthol finish. • Straw-Raspberry Cherry Ice A berry medley of Strawberry, Raspberry, and Cherry with a cooling kick. • Ten Tangerines A concentrated burst of sweet and tangy Tangerine citrus flavour. • Watermelon Ice The fresh, light taste of Watermelon chilled by a wave of Ice. How To Set Up Your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 6000 Device Step 1 Remove the silicone plug on the top of the 2ml prefilled pod and the sticker on the bottom. Step 2 Insert the 2ml prefilled pod into the 10ml refill container smoothly until it clicks into place. Step 3 Ensure the 2ml prefilled pod and the 10ml refill container are fully connected. Step 4 Insert the 10+2ml pod & refill into the device. Step 5 Enjoy vaping. Step 6 Press to switch between Turbo Mode and Normal Mode. Please note: Charging cable is not supplied. A USB-C cable can be purchased separately. Shop Dojo Blast 6000 Refill Pods
